ios.desc:
Sharpen your language skills by chatting with a language bot!
Chat with Juan (Spanish), Helga (German), FeiFei (Mandarin), and Britney (English)!
Built on OpenAI's GPT-3, Polyglot AI enables you to chat with a bot partner in Spanish, German, Chinese, or English.

Features:
Chat with a language bot: Find a bot friend to practice your language skills with!
Support for Spanish, German, Chinese, and English: We support Spanish, German, Chinese, and English today with more languages coming soon! 
Find a real language partner! You can also find and speak with a real language partner. Find folks based on interest and language!

By using this app, you agree to our Standard Terms of Use (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/) and Privacy Policy (https://polyglotchatbot.com/privacypolicy/).
